text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* The Portuguese Association of Beer Retailers presented a complaint to the Attorney-General against beer companies Centralcer and Unicer for their alleged disregard for competition rules.
* Only 55 workers and 17 small stockholders bought shares of steel company Lusosider in the privatisation yesterday of 10 percent of the capital of the company.
* Prime Minister Antonio Guterres told a news conference in Buenos Aires that Portugal's unemployment rate may be eight percent.
* Nelson Quintas e Filhos signs today a preliminary agreement with the government of the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais for a 10 billion escudos investment to build two factories.

* Credit Lyonnais Portugal has told the banking trade union it plans to reduce the number of its staff as negotiations continue with a view to sell its branches to Spanish regional bank Caixa da Galicia.
* Construction group Soares da Costa plans to dismiss 300 workers by the end of 1998, a source from the sector told the paper.
